about: W2-A2 planner v2 scripted-model ACCEPTANCE SET: multi-step cases run through the REAL panel (panelHarness + steps.js) against the scripted step server (testing/stepServer.js). The script IS the model: each item is one tool-use step (its target resolved from the turn's context or an earlier step's result) or the final reply. Expectations are what the browser executor reported back (step statuses), what the board holds afterwards, and what the member saw. No model call, no network, no market values. Runner: app/src/agent/agentPlannerV2Acceptance.test.jsx.

boards.ROOMY: one NVDA daily chart (12x10) with room for more; lists Swing (AAPL) and Momentum (NVDA, AMD); layouts Swing Board (open), Day Trading
boards.TWO: two charts NVDA | AMD filling the board; the same lists and layouts
boards.FOUR: four charts SPY QQQ NVDA TSLA; the same lists and layouts

targets: {section, index?} = that entry of the turn's context; {alias} = the `as` of an earlier step; {added, kind, index?} = a ref the latest DONE step created; {literal}
